headline: Siddhartha Roy Burman files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure for KSR Footwear Limited
sum: Substantial acquisition disclosure filed: Siddhartha Roy Burman has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating acquisition of 5% or more in KSR Footwear Limited.
detail: The disclosure has been formally filed with NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI SAST Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires persons acquiring 5% or more of a listed company's voting rights to make public disclosure. The filing confirms a material change of control or significant shareholding event at KSR Footwear Limited, a publicly listed footwear manufacturer. The specific acquisition price, final shareholding percentage, and acquisition timeline are not disclosed in the publicly available headline.
